scope: All Percept-generated files including PDF, PNG, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, ZIP, JSON, HTML, reports, drafts, approvals, sources and supporting files.

chatgpt_library.retention: Do not deliberately upload generated Percept files to ChatGPT Library. Chat conversation attachments and temporary local files may exist and cannot be universally disabled by this repository policy.

drive.routing: Known client/project -> corresponding Google Drive folder; unknown -> unclassified intake folder

workflow: Upload artifact bytes to Google Drive
Read back Drive file metadata (id, title, size, MIME, parent)
Compare expected attributes and checksum if bytes available
Write archival receipt with Drive file id, original filename, source, timestamps, SHA-256 if available, verification status
Only after verified Drive readback mark ARCHIVED

fail_closed.external_distribution: separate CEO approval and release gate; archival approval is not publication approval

completion_rule: Never say saved/synced/archived unless Google Drive returns success and independent readback confirms item. Never fabricate a Drive link.
enforcement_boundary: Applies to Percept-operated generators and integrations only when they call the archive gate; it does not install a platform-wide interception hook in ChatGPT or automatically archive unrelated existing conversation attachments.
